name: Bubbles and Sisters
source:
Life can't get any better!
You're living in the big city but your dreams meet a sudden halt when you're forced to move back home to save your fathers bath house business.

The bath house is located on top of a high mountain, it's filled with many strange guests. You're not alone tho, you've got your family and other employees to help you keep the show running.

[From [url=https://bubblesandsisters.itch.io/bubblesandsisters]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生活不能再好起来了！
你生活在大城市，但当你被迫搬回家以挽救父亲的浴室生意时，你的梦想突然停止。

澡堂位于高山之巅，里面挤满了许多陌生的客人。不过，你并不孤单，你的家人和其他员工可以帮助你维持演出。

[来自[url=https://bubblesandsisters.itch.io/bubblesandsisters]itch.io[/url]]
